names: C at the start of words

job_types.label: Writes the answer
job_types.how: Its output pushes the answer's own word: the answer is among the 10 words it raises most (read from its weights, run 1).

job_types.label: Pushes the answer up
job_types.how: Its output raises the answer as one of its words, without it being the top one (weights, run 1).

job_types.label: Recognises a thing
job_types.how: Switched off only at a thing's name (e.g. the words 'Eiffel Tower'), it breaks that thing's facts and few others (facts tests).

job_types.label: Knows the question type
job_types.how: Switched off, it breaks the same kind of question (e.g. 'which century') across many different things (facts tests).

job_types.label: Needed for one fact
job_types.how: Switched off, it breaks one particular fact, but not the thing's other facts or other things' same question (facts tests).

job_types.label: Picks out a century
job_types.how: Its firing separates people, places and works of one century from the rest, however the date is asked for (date test).

job_types.label: Tracks how a number is written
job_types.how: It fires for a digit in a particular place, e.g. years starting '17', not for the era itself (date and number tests).

job_types.label: A two-ended scale
job_types.how: Firing one way pushes towards one end of a scale (e.g. north), the other way towards the opposite end (south). Each end's description predicts which concepts use it, and pushing the neuron each way moves the model's answers towards that end (scales test, SCALES.md).

job_types.label: Shared answer machinery
job_types.how: It matters for answers of every kind: in the top 10 of more than 1% of concepts, or breaking facts generally (maps, facts tests).

job_types.label: One clear job in web text
job_types.how: A blind description of where it fires in web text passed our strict one-job check (census, H-DEPTH).

job_types.label: Has a checked name
job_types.how: Luna named it and the name passed a blind check against a concept Luna hadn't seen (JOB_NAMES.md).
